title: Paryushan ke aakhri din Pratikraman mein kya hota hai?
hooks: Samvatsari par ghante tak kyun baithte hain Jain?
Pratikraman: apni bhoolon se wapas lautne ka marg
Ek saal ki galtiyan kaise dhoote hain Jain?
hook_why: Immediate curiosity about the long duration of the ritual, which is a common observation for non-Jains and a relatable experience for Jains.
metaphor: A lotus blooming petal by petal — each of the six avashyakas opens one layer of the soul toward purity.
mechanism: Pratyakhyana: Taking a concrete future vow

cast.shravak: A Jain householder in simple white cotton kurta-pyjama, calm face, sitting on a clean mat in a marble-floored upashray
cast.muni: A Jain monk in plain white unstitched cotton robes, carrying a soft white rajoharan, serene face, standing in kayotsarga posture
cast.tirthankara_idol: A serene marble idol of a Tirthankara in padmasana, eyes half-closed, with a lotus emblem at the base, on a carved marble pedestal

scenes.vo: Samvatsari par ghante tak kyun baithte hain Jain?
scenes.prompt: Wide view of a white-marble Jain upashray at sunset, warm golden light on carved pillars. Devotees in simple cotton clothes sitting quietly. Serene, peaceful, uncluttered.
scenes.title: SAMVATSARI PRATIKRAMAN

scenes.vo: Pratikraman ka matlab hai apni bhoolon se wapas lautna.
scenes.prompt: A single shravak walking on a stone path in a temple courtyard, pausing and turning back gently. Warm golden light on white marble, ancient Jain architecture.
scenes.title: WAAPAS LAUTNA

scenes.vo: Agam kehta hai, karam dhyaan se hi chhutte hain.
scenes.prompt: An ancient palm-leaf manuscript resting on a carved wooden stand in a temple library, soft golden light illuminating the page. No readable text.
scenes.title: AGAM SUTRA

scenes.vo: Iske cheh avashyak hain, jo shuddhi ka marg dikhate hain.
scenes.prompt: Elegant vertical flow diagram on a marble background, six lotus petals opening upward, each labeled with a Sanskrit term in Roman script. Warm gold accents.
scenes.title: CHEH AVASHYAK

scenes.vo: Pehla: Samayika, 48 minute ki poori sthirta.
scenes.prompt: A shravak seated in padmasana on a clean cotton mat, eyes closed, utterly still. Soft golden grains of sand falling like a subtle hourglass. Warm gentle light, no text, no logos.
A row of 24 identical serene marble Tirthankara idols in a temple, each in padmasana. Devotee's hands folded in reverence. Golden light, carved pillars. Jain monks in plain white robes.
scenes.title: LOGASSA

scenes.vo: Teesra: Vandana, guru aur sadhuon ko naman.
scenes.prompt: The shravak bowing deeply before a Jain muni standing in kayotsarga posture, white robes, soft white rajoharan in hand. Marble temple corridor, warm light.
scenes.title: VANDANA

scenes.vo: Chautha: Pratikraman, har vrat ki bhool ka hisaab.
scenes.prompt: The shravak seated, eyes closed, one hand on heart, mentally reviewing. A lotus petal turning inward, representing vows. Serene, introspective. Jain monk in plain white robes nearby.
scenes.title: PRATIKRAMAN

scenes.vo: Paanchva: Kayotsarga, sharir chhod kar dhyaan.
scenes.prompt: The muni standing perfectly still in kayotsarga — feet together, arms hanging naturally, eyes half-closed. Marble temple floor, golden light, profound stillness. Wearing plain white robes.
scenes.title: KAYOTSARGA

scenes.vo: Chhatha: Pratyakhyana, aane wale samay ka naya sankalp.
scenes.prompt: A shravak rising from meditation, hands folded at heart, making a silent vow. A fresh lotus bud opening fully in golden light. Clean marble background, no text, no logos.
scenes.title: PRATYAKHYANA

scenes.vo: Samvatsari Pratikraman saal mein bas ek baar hota hai.
scenes.prompt: Crowded upashray interior — many shravaks and shravikas seated in rows on mats, muni at front reciting. Warm light through carved stone windows.
scenes.title: SAMVATSARI

scenes.vo: Ant mein Micchami Dukkadam. Aapne kab kiya Pratikraman? Save karo.
scenes.prompt: Devotees turning to each other with folded hands, saying Micchami Dukkadam. Warm golden light, marble temple courtyard, peaceful resolution, no text, no logos.

caption:
Samvatsari Pratikraman ke cheh avashyak jaante the aap? 🌸

Agam sutra se — shuddhi ka poora marg.

Aapne kab kiya Pratikraman? Comment mein batayein.

claims.claim: Samayika is a 48-minute period of equanimity meditation
